text:
Landed d875ecdf on main (single-developer mode, self-reported gate, LocallyObserved).

Gate: embedBench/test 96/96 with pinned MiniLM artifacts present (suite 10 total, 0 ignored);
scalafmtCheckAll clean. Mutations, each killed by exactly its named court with siblings green:
swapping first/last onset failed the timing court; publishing total source mass as
mapAnchorMass failed the confidence court. Localizability expectation recomputed independently
in the test.

Batch re-run (33 files, channel and posteriors unchanged from the neural run): all 5086 units
carry a recall-audio onset (100% - every word row in these CSVs is timed). Confidence columns
read: localizability mean 0.661 (q10 0.616, q90 0.697); mapAnchorMass median 0.115, margin
over runner-up median 0.020; only 12/5086 units concentrate >0.5 mass on one anchor.

Finding the columns surface: per-leaf mass is structurally diffuse - the 1000 microsegments
are fine-grained enough that adjacent rows describe nearly the same content, so the posterior
spreads over neighbours inside the nominee set. Localizability (entropy-based, normalized by
log K=1048) sits near 0.66 for almost every unit, i.e. concentrated relative to the whole
film but not to the nominee set. A consumer wanting a confident coarse answer should
aggregate anchor mass to the scene level; lodging that as its own candidate lever rather than
widening this slice.
